description.narrative: The Niger proposed project is aligned to the country COVID-19 preparedness and response plan that amounts to US$175 million, out of which the World Bank is financing US$13.9 million. The World Bank support will focus on strategic activities that will provide a platform for all donors and interventions. The World Bank's support will aim to align the many actors responding to the COVID-19 pandemic in Niger to promote synergies, complementarity and efficiency. The proposed project will consist of three components: Component 1: Emergency COVID-19 Response; Component 2: Communication campaign, community engagement and Behavior change; Component 3: Implementation Management and Monitoring and Evaluation.
To prevent, detect and respond to the threat posed by COVID-19 and strengthen national systems for public health preparedness in Niger

condition.narrative: No later than one (1) month after the Effective Date the Recipient, through the MOPH, shall update and adopt the projectimplementation manual for the Original Project (as so updated, “Project Implementation Manual” or “PIM”) in a manner and on termsacceptable to the Association

No later than thirty (30) days after the Effective Date (or such later date as agreed by the Association), the Recipient, throughthe MOPH, shall prepare a manual, in form and substance acceptable to the Association (“Project Implementation Manual” or “PIM”),containing, inter alia, detailed arrangements and procedures for: (i) implementation arrangements; (ii) administrative aspects;(iii) procurement; (iv) implementation of Environmental and Social Standards; (v) financial management and accounting; (vi)monitoring and evaluation; (vii) corruption and fraud mitigation measures; (viii) terms and conditions of Hazard Pay; (ix) personaldata collection and processing in accordance with applicable national law and good international practice; and (x) such othertechnical, administrative, fiduciary or coordination arrangements as may be necessary to ensure effective Project implementation

No later than thirty (30) days after the Effective Date (or such later date as agreed by the Association), the Recipient, throughthe MOPH, shall: prepare and adopt a manual, in form and substance acceptable to the Association (“Project Implementation Manual”or “PIM”), containing, inter alia, detailed arrangements and procedures for: (i) implementation arrangements; (ii) administrativeaspects; (iii) procurement; (iv) implementation of Environmental and Social Standards; (v) financial management and accounting;(vi) monitoring and evaluation; (vii) corruption and fraud mitigation measures; (viii) terms and conditions of Hazard Pay; (ix)personal data collection and processing in accordance with good international practice; and (x) such other technical,administrative, fiduciary or coordination arrangements as may be necessary to ensure effective Project implementation.

No later than thirty (30) days after the Effective Date, prepare and adopt, a manual for the Project COVID-19 Vaccine delivery anddistribution (“Vaccine Delivery and Distribution Manual”), in form and substance satisfactory to the Association.

The Recipient shall through the MOPH: (i) maintain up to six (6) months after the Effective Date, or until the MOPH-PIU assumesresponsibility for the Project, the Project Implementation Unit within the “Fonds Commun pour la SantE” (“FCS-PIU”) with acomposition, mandate and resources satisfactory to the Association; and (ii) designate said FCS-PIU to be responsible for theday-to-day implementation, coordination and management of the Project activities.

The Recipient shall, not later than November 30 in each calendar year during Project implementation (but not later than May 1, 2020for the first year of Project implementation), prepare and furnish to the Association for its approval, a program of Projectactivities proposed for implementation in the following calendar year.

Without limitation on the provisions of sub-paragraph (a) above, the Recipient shall no later than four (4) months after theEffective Date, establish and thereafter maintain throughout Project implementation, a new Project implementation unit within theMOPH's Secretary General office, with terms of reference, qualifications, integrity, composition, mandate and resourcessatisfactory to the Association.
